review_method: Project owner watched the clip and listed every pass as a kick->reception time range, plus the shot and the goal. This is a COMPLETE annotation of 0-97s, not a sample: every pass in that window is listed, so both recall and precision are meaningful over the whole clip.
scope: Full-clip reference for this video. Still one clip and one annotator; timestamps are read to the nearest second, hence the 1.5s matching tolerance.
time_basis: clip seconds; pass time = RECEPTION (end of the stated range), matching what the contact engine emits; shot = strike; goal = ball crossing the line
notes: 27 passes are listed. The clip is titled '30 passes'; the owner's count is the reference, not the title.
Two gaps are deliberate and are NOT missing passes: a player carries the ball between 0:39 and 0:43, and the receiver holds it between 1:05 and 1:09.
The pass at 1:02-1:05 is a long ball through the air across the field; every other pass is along the ground.
The pass at 1:31-1:34 is a through ball and is the ASSIST for the goal.
Balls are received at the feet, so reception should be judged at the foot position.
